about: The Princess Holiday Ball is a first annual family show in Lafayette.
It takes place Saturday, December 19, 2026 at The Arts Hub Theatre, 420 Courtney Way.
Sessions start at 10:30 AM, 1 PM and 3:30 PM.
Imagine More Character Company presents it.
Five princesses attend, including the Snow Sisters.
Each session has a 45-minute interactive performance.
The show includes live singing, dancing and an indoor snowball fight.
Kids get 30 minutes to meet each princess and take pictures.
General admission is $35 per child and $20 per adult.
VIP is $45 per child and $30 per adult, with reserved front rows, a tiara and hot chocolate.
Hot chocolate and treats are sold on site for general admission guests.
Royal attire is encouraged.
faq: When is the Princess Holiday Ball in Lafayette?
Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 10:30 AM, 1 PM or 3:30 PM.
Where is it?
The Arts Hub Theatre, 420 Courtney Way, Lafayette, CO 80026.
How much are tickets?
General admission is $35 per child and $20 per adult. VIP is $45 and $30.
How long is each session?
About 45 minutes of show plus 30 minutes to meet the princesses.
What does VIP include?
Reserved seats in the first two rows, a tiara for each child and free hot chocolate.
Do we need to dress up?
No, but princess dresses and holiday outfits are encouraged.
Who do I contact?
Email booking@imaginemorecc.com.

about: Once Upon a Holiday is a Holiday Princess Ball and Concert in Broomfield.
It is held Sunday, December 13, 2026.
The venue is The Chateaux at Fox Meadows, 13600 Xavier Lane.
Sessions run 10 to 11:45 AM and 3 to 4:45 PM.
Wands and Wishes Occasions hosts the event.
Professional princess singers perform live Christmas carols.
Characters appear in holiday attire and include Snow White, Cinderella, Elsa and Anna.
Santa Claus makes a special visit.
Tickets are $60 for children, $40 for adults and $20 for infants under one.
A Royal Group Portrait add-on is $15 and The Royal Coronation tiara is $25.
A beverage station and light snacks are included.
Guests should arrive 15 minutes before their session.
faq: When is Once Upon a Holiday in Broomfield?
Sunday, December 13, 2026, with sessions at 10 AM and 3 PM.
Where is it held?
The Chateaux at Fox Meadows, 13600 Xavier Lane, Broomfield, CO 80023.
How much does it cost?
Children $60, adults $40 and infants under one $20.
Does everyone need a ticket?
Yes, every attendee must have the right ticket.
Will Santa be there?
Yes, Santa makes a special visit.
Are photos included?
Guests take photos on their own devices. A group portrait is a $15 add-on.
Can parents drop kids off?
No, parents or guardians must stay with their children.
